_comment: Suite versions and capabilities. Suites are distributed as zip archives;
download links are in the README. `has_gt: false` means the suite has no 3D
ground truth by design, so the paired C1/C2 metrics are skipped for it.

category_rich.note: 3D ground truth available: the full paired protocol (C1 joint parameters, C2 part geometry, alignment, VLM judge) plus self-quality. Drawn entirely from the openly-licensed portion of the ArtiAtlas dataset.

in_the_wild.note: No 3D ground truth by design. Self-quality, image alignment and the VLM judge apply; C1/C2 are skipped automatically.
